name: Baby Registry Welcome Box
whatYouGet: Welcome box of baby products. The box shows a $35 charge at first and becomes $0 only if you apply your $35 promotional balance at checkout.
costDetail: Requires active Prime (Student Prime ok), a registry with 10 unique checklist items, and over $10 of registry purchases shipped.
eligibility: Primary registry owner with an active Prime account; Amazon Business accounts do not qualify.
catches: Tax, shipping, Prime and gift card purchases don't count toward the $10; box can't be claimed until qualifying items ship; contiguous US only (no APO, AK, HI, territories); 8-month wait between boxes; offer limited-time and may change.
notes: Some older pages mention a 60% checklist completion rule; the help page says 10 items. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.

name: Registry Welcome Kit (Target Baby Box)
whatYouGet: Welcome kit described as worth over $100, a mix of samples and Target Circle Bonus offers.
costDetail: Help article lists: join Target Circle, create a baby registry, add 10 unique items, make a purchase over $10 from the registry. Shipping and handling fees apply.
eligibility: Active baby registries created after 08/15/2023 that haven't claimed a previous kit; one kit per year.
catches: Offer is added to the Target Circle deal list and must be accepted; online only; shipping and handling fees apply; steps in the help article may predate the current offer.
notes: Check the registry dashboard for the current requirements. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.

name: Baby Registry Welcome Box
whatYouGet: Free box with at least six sample-size baby or parenting products plus discount coupons; items vary.
costDetail: Registry at least 7 days old with 20+ unique items and over $25 purchased through your registry link; then use Redeem on the My Registry tab.
eligibility: Adults 18+ in the 50 states and Puerto Rico; one box per person or address per 365 days.
catches: While supplies last; no guarantee everyone who completes the requirements receives a box; allow 10-12 weeks by mail; items marked purchased don't count toward the 20.
notes: Walmart's pages also mention a Postpartum Care Mom Box; no separate free mom box was confirmed. Terms reference a relaunch for registries created after Feb 1, 2025. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.

name: Hello Baby Box
whatYouGet: Free welcome box of product samples and partner offers (diapers/wipes, bottles, skincare, coupons); contents vary.
costDetail: Add 3 items from other stores, complete 40% of the registry checklist, make a $30+ Babylist Shop purchase (a gifter may), and pay $8.95 plus tax shipping.
eligibility: Arrival date under 9 months away or baby under 4 weeks old; one box per household and per registry; US addresses.
catches: Shipping fee is non-refundable and orders can't be changed; AK/HI total shipping $18.95; gift cards and return credit can't pay the fee; Babylist Health and other retailer orders don't count toward the $30.
notes: Babylist's marketing FAQ says one box per household per year; the help center rules differ slightly. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.

name: MacroBaby Gift Box
whatYouGet: Random, seasonal gift box valued at about $80 or more.
costDetail: Add at least 20 items to a registry and make a first qualifying purchase of $15 or more from it.
catches: Contents can't be requested; if the qualifying items are returned the box must be returned or an $80 fee applies; program can change or end without notice.
notes: MacroBaby also advertises 5% store credit on registry purchases. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.

name: Registry welcome bag
whatYouGet: Goody bag with free samples, coupons and a Registry Guide.
costDetail: Free with registry; available for pickup in stores only.
eligibility: Baby registrants; details of eligibility not confirmed.
catches: In-store pickup only; snippet may be outdated, so current availability and any conditions are unconfirmed.
notes: Search snippets also mention a 15% registry completion discount. Official site blocked fetching; entry based on official-domain search results.
